summary: commitlint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs probes for a local `bun` binary and otherwise downloads the Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and uses that freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute the adjacent `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator `WV8StW`, decode table `n7gIxM`, hex-mangled identifiers). The advertised purpose of the package is a commitlint configuration; `index.js` is a 12-line static commitlint config export, and math_init.js is never referenced by that entry point. The payload runs at `npm install` time, under a runtime downloaded on the fly, evading Node-only static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
